overview.stale.one: %[1]d open proposal has waited at least %[2]d hours for an answer.
overview.stale.other: %[1]d open proposals have waited at least %[2]d hours for an answer.

overview.disputes.one: %[1]d dispute is open or under review.
overview.disputes.other: %[1]d disputes are open or under review.

overview.posting.one: %[1]d dispute is decided but the reversal is not yet posted.
overview.posting.other: %[1]d disputes are decided but the reversal is not yet posted.

overview.limit.one: %[1]d active member is at or beyond their credit limit.
overview.limit.other: %[1]d active members are at or beyond their credit limit.

overview.check_none.other: No ledger check has been recorded yet.

overview.check_failed.other: The last ledger check found problems.

balance.limit_used.other: You are using %[1]s of your %[2]s credit limit.

status.explanation_1.other: Nothing has been posted yet. The amount is held aside from the payer's available credit until it is accepted, declined, cancelled or expires.

status.explanation_3.other: The other party declined. Nothing was posted.

status.explanation_4.other: Withdrawn before it was accepted. Nothing was posted.

status.explanation_5.other: Not answered in time. Nothing was posted.

status.explanation_6.other: A dispute is open. Postings stay as they were until a reviewer decides.

status.explanation_7.other: Fully reversed by a later posting.

financial.row.grant.receive.other: Sign-up grant: You will receive %[2]s %[3]s from %[1]s

footer.credits.other: Credits are accounting units used inside one network. They are a record of who has given and received value; they have no value outside it and are not guaranteed to be accepted.

terms.accept.other: I have read and accept these terms

session.ending.other: Your session is about to end.

dashboard.explain.other: Available to spend is not your balance: pending outgoing trades reduce it.

dashboard.needs_empty.other: Nothing is waiting for you. Proposals sent to you will appear here.

dashboard.recent_empty.other: No completed activity yet. Completed trades will appear here.

dashboard.outgoing_empty.other: You have no pending trades waiting for others.

notice.closing_date.other: This network closes on %[1]s. You can keep trading until then. Download your data before the date; read access continues for a while afterwards.

notice.membership_suspended.other: Your membership is suspended. You can view your trades and history, and decline or withdraw trades, but you cannot propose, accept or post. Contact the network administrator to ask about restoring it.

notice.membership_departed.other: You have left this network. You can still read your history and download your data.

notice.network_closed.other: This network is closed. History stays readable and exports are available; new trades are not possible.

notice.network_closing.other: This network has reached its closing date and is completing its closure. New trades are not possible; history stays readable and exports are available.

notice.admin_required.other: This network has no active administrator, so it is read-only (administrator required). You can read balances and history and download your data; nothing that moves value is possible until an administrator is appointed.

notice.trading_paused.other: Trading in this network is paused (suspended). You can read balances and history and download your data; new trades and acceptances are not possible until it resumes.

signals.intro.other: Signals point administrators and dispute reviewers to unusual activity. A signal is not a finding: it did not block or change any trade, and the members involved are not told. Look at their trades before you decide anything, and use the ordinary member and dispute tools if action is needed. A signal about you is not shown to you.

signals.settings.other: This network raises a signal when the trade proposals one member makes within a %[2]d-minute window exceed %[1]d, or when the trades two members complete with each other, in both directions, within a %[4]d-day window exceed %[3]d.

signals.settings_off.other: Activity signals are switched off in the network policy. Signals raised earlier are still listed.

signals.velocity.one: %[2]s made %[1]d trade proposal within a %[3]d-minute window, above the review threshold of %[4]d.
signals.velocity.other: %[2]s made %[1]d trade proposals within a %[3]d-minute window, above the review threshold of %[4]d.

signals.reciprocal.one: %[2]s and %[3]s completed %[1]d trade with each other, in both directions, within a %[4]d-day window, above the review threshold of %[5]d.
signals.reciprocal.other: %[2]s and %[3]s completed %[1]d trades with each other, in both directions, within a %[4]d-day window, above the review threshold of %[5]d.

signals.manage_hint.other: unusual proposal bursts and back-and-forth trading, for review

policy.signals_hint.other: Signals point administrators and dispute reviewers to unusual activity. They never block a trade and the members involved are not told. Members do not see these settings in the change log.

policy.velocity_proposals.other: Many proposals: signal when one member makes more than this many

policy.reciprocal_trades.other: Back-and-forth trades: signal when two members complete more than this many with each other, in both directions
